notes: REJECTED for device acceptance. Do not publish. Preview and Production use separate D1 databases; a Preview-targeted formal package must not be used as a drop-in upgrade for a Production-installed app.
rejectedReason: Preview build points at the isolated wyj-cloud-preview D1 database. Production accounts/sessions do not reliably exist there, so the signed preview APK can sign users out and reject their production credentials.
recovery: Rebuild the same 1.3.11 (24) candidate with BaseUrl=https://thewyj.uk and install it in-place. Do not uninstall or clear app data.
